outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single measured percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure time, not an average across replicates, so there are no underlying individual data points to display.
Panel B is a series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel D plots mean±s.e.m. photobleaching curves for n=5 replicates per laser power, but only the mean and error bars are shown; the individual data points/curves for the 5 replicates behind each mean are not displayed.
Panel E shows representative and pseudocolored images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the shaded mean±s.e.m. fit, so individual values are shown.
Panel G is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the shaded mean±s.e.m. fit, so individual values are shown.
Panel H is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the shaded mean±s.e.m. fit, so individual values are shown.
Panel I shows representative time-lapse micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel J plots the average photobleaching decay curve (mean±s.e.m.) from three independent experiments, but the individual curves/data points from the three replicates are not shown, only the averaged shaded trace.
